about.bio: Backend developer and solution designer, from analysis to delivery. I work with .NET, PHP and Python, model with UML and Merise, and ship with Docker and CI/CD pipelines. On the side, I'm exploring the modern frontend to keep pace with its evolution.

comete.b1: Designed a real-time assistance system helping agents optimize their conversations with customers.
comete.b2: Built a platform made of two applications: a desktop app (.NET with Avalonia, capturing audio from speakers and microphone) and a web app (ASP.NET Web API + React) that is the core of the system and the agent-facing interface.
comete.b3: Designed an API execution monitoring system.
comete.b4: Handled data management: ingestion, automatic updates and improvement of data management processes.

etech.b1: Worked with cross-functional teams to design and implement new features.
etech.b4: Took part in code reviews and helped improve code quality by adopting best practices.
